kjv: and he that regardeth not the day, to the Lord he doth not regard [it]
note: TR adds the converse clause about not observing the day; absent from Sinaiticus, A, B, C*, D.
TR "Christou" (from 2 Cor 5:10) against "theou" (Sinaiticus*, A, B, C*, D, F, G).

kjv: he that doubteth is damned if he eat
mine: whoever has doubts is condemned if he eats
note: katakekritai is "stands condemned" (self-condemned by conscience); "damned" now implies eternal perdition for eating with a doubtful conscience.
